note: Mostly seasonal: about 68 of its 146 sites are sold by the night. Near Leask, with a sandy beach, boat launch, fish-cleaning station and a 9-hole golf course. Daily sites are grass and gravel among mature trees; power posts can be far from the pad (the park suggests a 25-ft extension cord). The gate is locked 9 pm to 7 am and there is no entry overnight. Campsites rent only to those 19 and older unless with a parent or guardian. --Claude
